posts.title: Doing everyone else's job
posts.description: I find it very useful to be able to do everyone else’s job — it helps you learn how they work and what they need, and it helps even more when you need their job done, but they won’t do it themselves. If you made something new and those you made it for can’t be bothered to start using it, go ahead and integrate it into their system.
